items.summary: Starbucks same-store sales fall for a fourth consecutive quarter.
Starbucks CEO says the company's turnaround will take longer than expected.
Starbucks introduces a new fall menu and protein cold foam.
A union files a complaint against Starbucks over store closures.
Data show consumer spending on dining out is slowing.
Starbucks plans to open 500 stores in China this year.
